text:
anna_sales: Heads-up — customer Alan (gov agency) asked if we can do the POC via physical media only (no network egress). They want chain-of-custody & signing answers. Anyone have the short checklist? :eyes:

lucas_se: We can produce an air-gapped bundle. Couple clarifying Qs: expected update cadence? Do they accept encrypted USB or sealed SSD shipping? Also, do they want us to sign with Redwood keys or allow import of their HSM cert?

customer_alan: Prefer encrypted SSD shipped via courier. Weekly deltas not allowed — target quarterly security patches for the pilot. Must have signed SBOM + manifest checksum.

nina_security: We can do SBOM (SPDX) + signatures. For closed-loop, we support signed delta patches. Customer-managed HSM is supported but requires onboarding docs and a key-import procedure.

mike_ops: Shipping encrypted disk is fine from our side. Need to confirm courier will handle tamper-evident seals and chain-of-custody forms. Recommend verification procedure: run sha256sum on /opt/redwood/manifest.txt and verify against included .sig using our verification tool.

sara_legal: Licensing clarification: offline deployments — do they want a perpetual license file that never expires or a time-limited license with annual support? Pricing differs significantly. @anna_sales please confirm commercial preference.

anna_sales: Alan says they'd prefer a perpetual license (one-time) with an annual support contract. Also wants the ability to rollback to previous bundle if a patch breaks the POC.

lucas_se: Rollback is supported. Each bundle includes the previous-version snapshot and we ship a rollback runbook. Note: rollback is manual — operators will need to run the revert script and re-import KV-cache state. We'll document required steps.

nina_security: Heads-up: customer-managed KMS/HSM onboarding usually takes 2–3 weeks. Also clarify whether they're doing an onsite key ceremony or remote import with attestation; remote import still needs video + audit trail per our policies.

customer_alan: They prefer on-prem HSM with Redwood's signing certificate imported. Onsite key ceremony is possible but they'd prefer remote import with recorded attestation if that shortens timeline.

mike_ops: Ops notes for packaging: delta bundles will be signed + encrypted. Recommend shipping <4GB per removable device to control courier costs. Also call-out: target host kernel >=5.10 and disk encryption userspace (we'll include dracut/initramfs hooks).

anna_sales: Commercial ask: with perpetual license + quarterly patches + on-prem HSM onboarding, what's the expected pricing uplift and PS hours? Sara?

sara_legal: We'll put an SOW addendum for offline delivery + KMS/HSM onboarding. Ballpark uplift: one-time packaging fee (18–25% of license) + PS for onboarding (estimated 40–80 hrs depending on onsite vs remote). I'll draft numbers and send to the thread.

lucas_se: I'll start the technical runbook repo items: (1) bundle verification steps, (2) rollback runbook, (3) HSM import guide, (4) SBOM verification CLI example. Will link once initial draft is ready.

anna_sales: Can we promise the signed SBOM verification hook that runs locally without network? Nina?

nina_security: Yes — we'll produce SBOM in SPDX and sign with our org key. For customer-managed HSM we can provide a local validation hook that verifies the signature with the imported cert. Note: we cannot vouch for the customer's courier SOC2 controls.

deploy-bot: Package build complete — artifact sha256: abcdef1234567890deadbeefcafebabe7f1c2d3e4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5 (truncated).

anna_sales: Thanks all. Action items: Sara to draft addendum (due Tue), Lucas to share runbook (Mon), Nina to provide HSM onboarding checklist (Wed). Customer requested a 1:1 next Wed 10am PT — please confirm availability.

customer_alan: Confirmed Wed 10am PT works. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
